text: [Song of Ascents *{* The Songs of Ascents (Pss 120-134) were sung by pilgrims on their way up to Jerusalem.} ] To Yahweh when I am in trouble I call and he answers me.
Yahweh, save me from lying lips and a treacherous tongue!
What will he repay you, what more, treacherous tongue?
War-arrows made sharp over red-hot charcoal.
How wretched I am, living in Meshech, dwelling in the tents of Kedar!
Too long have I lived among people who hate peace.
When I speak of peace they are all for war!
